title: Tensor with a flat constructible étale sheaf preserves bounded constructibility
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring. On the small étale site use the constant ring sheaf $\Lambda_X$ and its module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $L$ be a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] which is flat, meaning that $-\otimes_{\Lambda_X}L$ is exact [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Regard $L$ as $L[0]$ in the unbounded derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and let $K\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. For the ordinary étale derived tensor product [def-kun-derived-tensor], there are natural isomorphisms
$$\mathcal H^i(K\otimes^L_\Lambda L[0])\cong\mathcal H^i(K)\otimes_{\Lambda_X}L\qquad(i\in\mathbf Z).$$
These cohomology sheaves are constructible. Consequently $K\otimes^L_\Lambda L[0]\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$, and every cohomological interval $[a,b]$ containing the cohomology of $K$ also contains the cohomology of this tensor product. No finite Tor amplitude is required of $K$.

proof.text: Work directly in the existing ModuleCat-valued small-etale sheaf category and its adopted derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Exactness of tensorRight L and the braiding give ObjectProperty.flat L. CochainComplex.kFlat_single_obj_iff_flat makes L[0] K-flat. DerivedCategory.isIso_tensorRightCounit and the monoidal quotient comparison make the canonical tensorator Q(C) tensor Q(L[0]) to Q(C tensor L[0]) invertible for every C. Collapse the signed total tensor using mapBifunctorSingle₂Iso. Compose its homology image with the exact-functor homology comparison [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology]. Check simultaneous naturality: on the surviving (i,0) summand it is naturality of the single-object identification, and all other summands have zero source; ShortComplex.homologyMap_mapNatTrans gives naturality of exact-functor homology. Descend the resulting natural isomorphism along Q using [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. To verify naturality for maps between flat L, restrict the two natural transformations along Q, use tensorator naturality and the cochain comparison square, and cancel the homology factorization isomorphism. Finally restrict the first variable to bounded constructible objects.

proof.text: Unpack the stratifications of H^i(K) and L from [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] and [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Convert their finite-value trivializations to finite local constancy using [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values]. Retain the same strata, immersions and constructibility proofs as FiniteLocallyClosedStratification inputs to [lem-fd-constructible-tensor-refinement-witness], obtaining constructibility of H^i(K) tensor L. Use [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison] and invariance of constructible sheaves under isomorphism to transport this across step 1.

proof.text: Where $\mathcal H^i(K)=0$, step 1 identifies the tensor cohomology with $0\otimes_{\Lambda_X}L=0$. Thus every cohomology interval $[a,b]$ for $K$ is also one for its tensor with $L[0]$. Combining these bounds with step 2 gives membership in $D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ by [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes]. Only $L$ was assumed flat.
